pattern.title: Bead pattern maker
pattern.subtitle: Upload pixel art. One art pixel becomes one bead. Match to MARD, Perler, Hama, Artkal, Nabbi, IKEA Pyssla, and more. Tell us which colours you own and we only use those.
pattern.aboutTitle: Pixel art patterns for fuse bead projects
pattern.aboutBody: Poofpixels is a browser based pattern maker for fuse beads, iron beads, Perler style beads, Hama beads, MARD, Artkal, and mixed bead collections. Upload an image, clean it into bead sized pixels, adjust colours, and export a pattern you can build from.
pattern.chartLinkLabel: Browse the MARD colour chart on this site
pattern.mixedPaletteHint: Matches against every brand palette together. Mixed-mode codes include the brand name.
pattern.mixedBrandsEmpty: Select at least one brand to mix.
pattern.inventoryHint: Choose your brand, lines, and individual beads before or after opening a project.

pattern.oneToOneNote: One art pixel = one bead. If your PNG is upscaled (e.g. 54×54 for an 18×18 sprite), we merge each uniform block automatically.
pattern.pixelBlockHint: Merges upscaled blocks first (2×2, 3×3, etc.), then canvas width scales the bead grid. You can use both together.
pattern.pixelBlockNoneDetected: No upscaled blocks detected, using every file pixel

matchMethodHint.lab76: Uses Lab ΔE76, a solid perceptual default for bead colours.
matchMethodHint.lab2000: Uses Lab ΔE2000, which can choose different neighbours for subtle shades.
matchMethodHint.rgb: Uses straight sRGB distance; simple, but less accurate to the eye.
matchMethodHint.weightedRgb: RGB with extra weight on green; sometimes closer to how monitors look.

pattern.trimTransparentHint: Trims empty transparent edges before building the grid, useful when sprites have extra canvas space.
pattern.removeBgHint: Removes background colours connected to the image edge, while keeping matching colours inside the sprite.
pattern.imageScaledNote: Large image, analysed at {analysisWidth}×{analysisHeight} (original {fileWidth}×{fileHeight}) so the page stays responsive.
pattern.canvasPreviewNote: Large pattern, preview uses canvas for performance ({count} beads).

colors.artkalCInfoTitle: Artkal C vs A mini beads
colors.artkalCInfoC: Artkal C-2.6mm mini beads are the hard mini line. Artkal says they are made from food-grade PE, come in 178 colours, and can be mixed with Perler, Hama, and other hard fuse bead brands.
colors.artkalCInfoA: Artkal A-2.6mm mini beads are the soft, flexible mini line. Artkal says they are made from food-grade EVA, come in 186 colours, and should be used separately instead of mixed with harder bead brands.
colors.artkalCInfoSource: Artkal FAQ: A-2.6mm vs C-2.6mm mini beads
colors.mard221CutoffNote: The classic 221-colour MARD set usually covers the A-H series plus M. The P · Pastels & Specials section is the first section after that usual 221-set cut-off.
colors.mard264Note: The “264 colours” 2.6 mm listing needs confirmation against a current supplier picker. In our captured listing it showed 265 rows: the 221 base plus P1-P23, Q2 and Q5 only, R1-R13, T1, and Y1-Y5.
